brief: inline (measurement instruments named by corpus but absent from disk)
outputs_expected: 67 phantom tools named in C8 warnings from node tools/corpus-index.mjs
findings: Baseline: node tools/corpus-index.mjs reports 67 phantom tools (C8), 0 errors.

build-viability.mjs DONE. Imports the SHIPPING predicates (sheet.js composeCharacter; gate.js FactionGates/canOffer/canResolve; rules.js computeDamage; resolve.js mitigate; reaction.js derivedDisposition) rather than reimplementing them. --self-test PASSES 8/8 and falsifies ALL FOUR criteria independently.
Real-data result: 540/540 viable, exit 0. All-true is only credible because the fixture overlays prove it can say no (RI-MTH06 M3).

DATA DEFECT: regions.json declares no `tier` on any of its 13 regions and encounters.json declares none either, so RI-CHR01 criterion 4's 'tier-5 region' has NO REFERENT in shipped data. Tool substitutes every non-prop enemy at the highest shipped enemy tier (champion_hist_marked, cst_sap_speaker; both tier=elite) and prints the substitution on every run.
DATA DEFECT: progression/levels.json stops at level 5 (declared wave-1 skeleton) so there is no shipped level->attribute curve for the level-55 projection. Model parameters declared in report.model.

DATA DEFECT: progression/factions.json holds 2 factions (house-dres, shadowscale-order) which appear NOWHERE in quests/faction-gates.json's 9 ladders. The two files disagree about which factions exist.
game/src/sim/quest/gate.js exports FactionGates, canOffer, canResolve - the shipping gate predicates. Any tool asking about gates should import these, not reimplement.

Harness surface is 264 methods. Includes gamepad, gamepadPoll, getUIState, setUIVisible, getPerfStats, stallMainThread, getStorageInfo, listSaveSlots, screenshot, getCaptureState, streamAround, advanceWallClock - the journey/platform/ui tools have real seams.
C8 count 67 -> 61 after the journey block.

gamepad-shim.mjs self-test 5/5 incl. null control. KEY FINDING for RI-JRN04: the shim installs above navigator.getGamepads() and works (mapping:'' preserved, hot-plug fires both events). journey-run's jrn04 leg reports getgamepads_calls: if the BUILD never calls navigator.getGamepads(), its pad path starts below that seam and the descriptor leg is not passable - a build defect, not a tool gap.

beat-extract.mjs self-test 6/6 incl. leak-detector falsification. Reference side committed ONCE at corpus/88-journeys/data/mw-open-beats.json (MW/OPEN rows 3-12 in the same 4-field form as our side) per RI-MTH06 §C. beat-extract refuses to write that file.

cadence.mjs self-test 5/5. Falsifications: 300s dead gap turns C1 red; pure locomotion is NOT counted as activity (an hour walking in a circle must not read as engaged); empty trace is unmeasurable not a pass.

competence.mjs self-test 5/5. Falsifications: K7 VOIDS an improvement measured against a weaker late enemy; a build declaring enemy DECISION-MAKING absent cannot claim a competence curve at all (K6's punish window does not exist against a scripted enemy).

BLOCKER (transient, another agent): game/src/render/renderer.js imports ./title.js which does not exist yet -> the game does not boot. W1-26 is mid-write on render/text-register.js + title.js. journey-run --self-test cannot complete until that lands. RETRY IT.

W1-26 is adding __HARNESS.getRenderedText() (render/text-register.js): fillText-level and CLIP-AWARE. journey-run.mjs already prefers it over getUIState().text and names which accessor it used + how strong it is.

*** THE GAME DOES NOT CURRENTLY BOOT *** (as of this writing, not my change). Engine._boot -> new RealInput -> new TouchInput -> TouchInput._assertLayout THROWS: "RI-JRN04 H11: touch controls 'heavy' and 'parry' are 6.9 px apart, below the 8 px minimum" (game/src/input/touch.js:74). window.__HARNESS.ready() rejects, so EVERY browser-based tool in the tree exits 12. The assertion is correct and is doing its job; the touch layout that violates it is the defect. Owner: whichever agent is on RI-JRN04 touch controls.

journey-run self-test found TWO bugs in its own first version, which is the argument for having one: (1) it blinded only getUIState while the build had grown getRenderedText, so the blinding test passed vacuously - BOTH accessors are now blinded; (2) it opened the census surface before testing movement, and a dialogue surface legitimately blocks locomotion, so it was measuring the surface not the input path - the real-input check now runs FIRST.

beats-from-md.mjs 5/5 incl. two falsifications (a mangled t_target and a non-beat row both make it REFUSE rather than emit a short sheet). Generated corpus/95-experience/RI-EXP01.beats.json: 18 beats + 13 derived targets. --check is the drift gate.

beat-extract.mjs (experience) 8/8. Falsifications: found_not_given does NOT fire when a topic named the item first, and a topic AFTER the pickup does not retro-convert it ('at the time it fires' is load-bearing for T_found, RI-EXP01's headline metric); combat requires an AGGRO hostile not just an attack; death fires only for the player; odd is silenced by a nearby quest_stage.

session-run.mjs enforces its profile prohibitions IN THE PAGE (replaces the __HARNESS methods), not Node-side, because a driving agent reaching window.__HARNESS via page.evaluate would walk past a Node-side check. RI-EXP01: any invocation VOIDS the run. Added a 'build-identity' profile for RI-CMP03 that also refuses setSkills/setAttributes/setMagicSkills/setGold/learnSpell - AGENT-PROTOCOL's 'never grant yourself the thing under test'.
C8 count now 55 (from 67). 12 tools written.

COLLISION: another agent overwrote my tools/experience/beats-from-md.mjs with their own (more complete: it also extracts the partial order and the 7 hard fails). I did NOT fight for the file - theirs stays. Theirs currently THROWS ('parsed only 5 order constraints; expects >=8'), correctly refusing to emit a weakened partial order, so RI-EXP01.beats.json on disk is still the one my version generated (schema elder-souls/beat-sheet@1). beat-diff.mjs was made SCHEMA-TOLERANT and reads either shape (tol vs tolerance_min, F/G vs found/given, derived_targets array vs object) with a self-test proving both give identical verdicts.

beat-diff.mjs 9/9. Falsifications: a beat outside tolerance is LATE not HIT; one observation cannot satisfy two sheet beats (else a single lucky event inflates beats_hit). Implements RI-EXP01 STEP 5 (the negative artifact) on every missing row - the search performed and its empty output - which is the step that usually gets dropped.

isolation-check.mjs 6/6. Falsifications: catches a beat-sheet read hidden inside a Bash command line (where leaks actually hide - `cat corpus/...` never appears in a file_path field); an inbox that materialises a WHOLE reference item is VOID by construction (§D is in the same file as §C); 'enforced' with no tool-call log degrades to 'attested' and caps the item at 6 rather than passing.
log-lint.mjs 8/8 incl. a false-positive control (a genuinely neutral 5-line log passes - a lint that fires on everything gets deleted rather than obeyed). Exits 20 as PLAYTHROUGH-CRITIC §5.4 names.
FINAL: C8 = 55 (from 67). 12 tools written, 10 verified by self-test against a running system, 2 (journey-run, session-run) NOT verifiable because THE GAME DOES NOT BOOT.

BOOT BLOCKER #2 (current, not mine): QuestBook: 8 integrity failures - Q-MAIN-15's consequences name Q-MAIN-16..Q-MAIN-23, none of which exist. game/src/sim/quest/defs.js:48 throws in Engine._boot, so __HARNESS.ready() rejects and EVERY browser tool exits 12. Owner: whichever agent is writing the main-quest chain. (The earlier touch.js layout blocker was fixed by its owner in the meantime.)
build-viability re-run after the new main quests landed: 53 quests walked (was 38), categories now include 'main', still 540/540 viable, self-test still 8/8. The tool is live to data changes.
RI-MTH06 M2 (exit-code contract) verified: all 12 tools exit 0 on --help with a usage block.

UNVERIFIED, MUST RE-RUN WHEN THE GAME BOOTS: `node tools/journey/journey-run.mjs --self-test` and `node tools/experience/session-run.mjs --self-test`. journey-run's PREVIOUS version did run green-boot and scored 3/5; the two failures were bugs in the self-test itself and are fixed, but the fixed version has never seen a booting game. gamepad-shim DID pass 5/5 against a booting game.
next_step: Re-verify session-run.mjs and journey-run.mjs self-tests once the game boots (touch.js layout assertion currently blocks boot). Remaining C8: 55.
